purpose: Records the REVIEW and TEST verdicts of a round as files committed by REVIEW: and TEST: commits, and judges stage order within a round, so round boundaries show in git and Finalise can judge the last round only.
responsibilities: write rcf/verdicts/<h12>/review.json from rcf build verdict review at the reviewed head H (the committed HEAD)
write rcf/verdicts/<h12>/test.json from rcf build verdict test for the reviewed head H, from a TAP summary of the full RCF suite run locally
judge round order in rcf audit separation: stages monotonic within a round, a regression to DEFINE: legal only as the commit right after a failed verdict, verdict heads checked

interfaces.name: rcf build verdict review
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf build verdict review --fbs <id>[,<id>...] --acs <AC id>[,...] --code MERGE|FINDINGS --adequacy PASS|FINDINGS [--finding "<spec|build>:<AC id|->:<text>"]... [--by <text>] (default recordedBy: "reviewer"; the test verb's default is "verifier")
Writes rcf/verdicts/<first 12 of HEAD>/review.json for the committed HEAD (the reviewed head H); for a spec at inProgress, --acs must include every live acId of that spec, else exit 3 "[error] brokenReference touched criteria omit <ids> of <fbs-id> (inProgress)" and prints "verdict: review <code>/<adequacy> at <h7> written to rcf/verdicts/<h12>/review.json"; never commits. Exit 0 written; 4 refused ("verdict refused: working tree is dirty; a verdict names a committed head" for any change outside rcf/verdicts/; "verdict refused: a review verdict for <h7> already exists at <path>"); 3 broken reference ("[error] brokenReference <AC id> is not scoped by <fbs ids>", unknown FBS); 2 usage (FINDINGS on either axis with no --finding: "[error] usage FINDINGS needs at least one --finding"; a --finding not matching <spec|build>:<AC id|->:<text>; --code or --adequacy outside its pair).

interfaces.name: rcf build verdict test
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf build verdict test --fbs <id>[,...] --result PASS|FAIL --tap <file> --runtime "<text>" [--reason <text>] [--by <text>]
Finds the reviewed head H from the newest rcf/verdicts/*/review.json reachable from HEAD whose fbsIds include every --fbs id (--fbs must equal that verdict's fbsIds as a set, else exit 2 "[error] usage --fbs <ids> differs from the REVIEW verdict's fbsIds <ids>") and writes rcf/verdicts/<h12>/test.json; when rcf/verdicts/<H12>/test.json already records PASS and --result is FAIL, it writes rcf/verdicts/<HEAD12>/test.json with head HEAD instead (stage-keeper ruling 3); --result PASS refuses (exit 4) when rcf/verdicts/<H12>/test-strength.json exists with result fail: "verdict refused: test-strength at <H7> fails for <ids>; record --result FAIL"; prints "verdict: test <result> at <H7> (<pass> pass, <fail> fail, <skip> skip, <todo> todo) written to rcf/verdicts/<h12>/test.json". Exit 0 written; 4 refused ("verdict refused: no REVIEW MERGE with adequacy PASS recorded for <H7>" unless --result FAIL; "verdict refused: HEAD differs from the reviewed head <H7> outside rcf/verdicts/, rcf/verify-reports/ and FINALISE classes"; "verdict refused: the TAP summary reports <k> failing; record --result FAIL"; "verdict refused: the TAP summary does not include bound test <pointer> of <AC id>"; dirty tree); 2 usage ("[error] usage --tap <file> carries no TAP summary"; FAIL with zero failing tests and no --reason).

interfaces.name: ReviewVerdict v1
interfaces.description: fields: verdictVersion (1), stage ("review"), head (40-hex reviewed head H), fbsIds (array), touchedAcIds (array; every id scoped by one of fbsIds), code (MERGE | FINDINGS), adequacy (PASS | FINDINGS), findings (array of { id "F-<n>", locus spec | build, acId (AC id or null), text }), recordedBy (string), recordedAt (ISO time). Passed when code is MERGE and adequacy is PASS; failed otherwise (a failed verdict closes the round).

interfaces.name: TestVerdict v1
interfaces.description: fields: verdictVersion (1), stage ("test"), head (40-hex: the reviewed head H, or for a FAIL recorded after a PASS at H, the HEAD it was recorded at), fbsIds (array), result (PASS | FAIL), suite ({ pass, fail, skip, todo, cancelled } integers from the TAP summary), runtime (free text naming the locally running app, for example "node bin/rcf.js from the packed head installed in a scratch project"), node (process.version of the verb), reason (string or null), recordedBy, recordedAt. FAIL closes the round.

interfaces.name: Round state machine
interfaces.description: States DEFINE, BUILD, REVIEW, TEST, FINALISE (stage index 1 to 5). A commit may stay in the current stage or move to any later one. Closing events: a REVIEW: commit adding a failed ReviewVerdict, a TEST: commit adding a FAIL TestVerdict, and a TEST: commit adding a TestStrengthReport whose result is fail. A FINALISE: commit is never followed by DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW: or TEST: in the same round, with one exception (stage-keeper ruling 3): after a TEST PASS at H, a TEST: commit adding a FAIL TestVerdict whose head is that commit's parent is legal after TEST: or FINALISE: commits and closes the round. A FINALISE: merge from main whose resolution needs a code fix is never committed; the verifier records that FAIL instead. After H the round holds exactly one REVIEW: commit, the one adding the verdict for H; a further REVIEW: after a passed verdict fails "<sha7> REVIEW: after a passed REVIEW verdict (one REVIEW verdict per round)". A TEST: commit adding a test.json when the round holds no passed REVIEW verdict fails "<sha7> TEST: verdict with no passed REVIEW verdict in the round"; a TEST: or REVIEW: commit adding no verdict file is judged on classes and counts as no verdict. After a closing commit the next commit must be DEFINE: (a new round); any other regression fails "<sha7> <STAGE>: after <PREV>: without a failed verdict (stage order is monotonic within a round)"; a non-DEFINE commit right after a closing verdict fails "<sha7> <STAGE>: after a failed verdict; the next round starts at DEFINE:". A REVIEW: commit's verdict head must be its parent ("<sha7> REVIEW: verdict head <x7> is not its parent <p7>"); a TEST: verdict head must be the round's reviewed head ("<sha7> TEST: verdict head <x7> is not the reviewed head <H7>"), except the post-PASS FAIL above, whose head is its parent. A range may start in any stage (its DEFINE merged earlier).

notes: Answers D-02 (audit section 5) under Q-05 b: the TEST pass is a branch commit; Finalise accepts the reviewed head H plus TEST: and FINALISE: commits within their file classes. The 0.36.x verify report under rcf/verify-reports/<fbs-id>/ stays verifierEvidence (TEST) for the transition.
name: Rounds and verdict records: rcf build verdict review and test, the verdict files and the round state machine
